leads.topic: GE TCAL28 / TCAL38 / TCAL39 / TCAL51 / TCAL62 not found
leads.detail: These numbers appear in the batch scope but are not in the GE BuyLog 2008 excerpt or the 2012, 2013 or 2019 lug tables. TCAL28 may be confused with TCAL28PD1/PD3 (SF power distribution lugs). Older GE lug numbers (TCAL2x/3x for the 1980s-90s TF/TJ lines) may appear in GEP-1100 / GET-xxxx renewal catalogs or older BuyLog editions (pre-2008).

leads.topic: GE footnote digits fused into part numbers
leads.detail: The pdftotext extraction of GE BuyLog runs footnote superscripts into part numbers (TCAL1212 = TCAL121 + fn2, TCAL811 = TCAL81 + fn1, TCLK3652 = TCLK365 + fn2, SKLVK6 = SKLVK + fn6, etc.). Base numbers were reconciled across the 2012 and 2019 editions (different footnote numbering). TCAL122, TCALK2122/3122, TCAL91, TCALK291/391, TCAL131 and 789A448G3 are inferred bases (conf B/C). Check them against distributor or ABB product pages.

leads.topic: Siemens QJ2 / pre-Sentron ITE lug kits
leads.detail: SPEEDFAX 2017/2021 no longer lists QJ2, so the only QJ2 lug found is TA1Q300 (distributor). Old ITE numbers such as TA1D/3TA1D/TA1E/TA1F/TA1G/TA2DS/TA3J6500/TA2P400 were not found in the 2017 tables. Search older SPEEDFAX editions (e.g. SPEEDFAX 2004-2011, Section 7) and ITE 'Breaker Lug Selection' leaflets.

leads.detail: The E150 reference list cites GEJ-3609 (back-connected studs) and GEH-4610 (plug-in mounting base). The lug kit instruction GEH/DEH numbers were not found; download them from library.e.abb.com.

log: Downloaded GE BuyLog Section 6 Rev 1/19 (mirror), Section 6 Rev 11/13, Section 3 Rev 9/12, a 2008 Section 3 excerpt and a single 2013 lug page. Downloaded Siemens SPEEDFAX 2017 Section 7 (Coburn's mirror; the Siemens support URL returned an HTML stub) and the 2021 Section 7 revision (IPS mirror). Extracted with pdftotext -layout. GE source tables: p. 6-102 (general lugs, copper lugs, line shields, TKM lug covers), 6-103 (Spectra lugs, covers, LV kits), 6-104 (PD lugs), 6-36/37 (TJJ/TJK lug columns), 6-48 (SG lug kits), 6-73/78/81/88 (Record Plus) and 6-101 (back-connected studs). Footnote superscripts are fused into part numbers in the GE extraction. Base numbers were resolved by comparing the 2012 and 2019 footnote numbering, and the as-printed variants are recorded as alias alt_part_numbers. Prior TCAL numbers (TCAL812, TCAL1214, etc.) are print artifacts, not supersessions. Genuine table changes 2012 to 2013/2019: TCAL27, TCALK341, TCALK343, TCALK347, TJLVK, 789A448G3(?) and 286A8066G1 were dropped. Siemens tables used: 7-39/7-40 (BQ/QR2), ED/FD/JD/MD/PD breaker pages, 7-153/154/155 (lug master tables), 7-160 (terminal shields) and 7-165 (rear-connecting studs). Not found: GE TCAL28/38/39/51/62, Siemens TA1D/TA1F/TA1G/TA2DS/TA2P400/TA3J6500 and an OEM QJ2 lug table. No OEM supersession tables were found. Distributor web fetches were limited (superbreakers 429). Plug-in bases, mounting screw kits and VL lugs were deferred (see leads).
